summary: Siuslaw NF tower site: 30-ft CCC tower (1934 per Oregon Forest Lookouts), 40-ft L-4 from 1948; damaged or destroyed in a 1954/55 windstorm; listed as gone.

facts.design: L-4 timber tower; last one 40 ft (built 1948)
facts.status_note: Tower destroyed or removed after a mid-1950s windstorm and never replaced; sources give 1954 or 1955. No tower stands per the Forest Fire Lookout Association list.

events.note: 30-ft timber L-4 tower with hip-roof cab, built by the CCC (Oregon Forest Lookouts). The register dates a 30-ft tower to 1948 instead.
Short-wave radio installed for communication between lookout and ranger station.
Telephone line, about seven miles, run up to the lookout (quoted from The Salt forest newsletter).
Activated March 19, 1942, for the Portland Filter Center.
40-ft wooden L-4 tower built in 1948 to replace the first tower.
Lookout severely damaged during a wind storm (Oregon Forest Lookouts).
40-ft tower destroyed in a 1955 storm and never replaced (register and firelookout.com). Oregon Forest Lookouts dates the storm damage to 1954.
Registered September 23, 2010, nominated by Ray Kresek (US 674, OR 106).

evidence.quote: A tower will be put up on Buzzard Butte on the divide between Sand lake and the watershed of the Nestucca, on the Hebo ranger district.

evidence.quote: 1934: A 30-foot timber tower with an L-4 hip-roof cab constructed by the CCC.

evidence.supports: short-wave radio linked lookout with ranger station (1936)
evidence.quote: The past summer, we installed a 5-meter shortwave radio transmitter and receiver for communication between the lookout and the Ranger Station.

evidence.supports: telephone crew finished seven miles of line up to the tower (April 1937)
evidence.quote: Kenneth Thorall and his telephone crew have just completed a job of putting in 7 miles of telephone line, up to the lookout tower on Buzzard Butte.

evidence.supports: 40-ft wooden L-4 tower replaced the first tower in 1948
evidence.quote: replaced with a 40' wooden L-4 tower in 1948

1948 40-foot timber tower with L-4 cab (Oregon Forest Lookouts)
evidence.quote: 1948: A 40-foot timber tower with an L-4 cab constructed.

evidence.supports: register places the first 30-ft tower in 1948 (conflict with 1934)
evidence.quote: A 30' L-4 tower was built in 1948

evidence.supports: Oregon Forest Lookouts dates severe wind damage to 1954
evidence.quote: 1954: The lookout severely damaged during a wind storm.

evidence.quote: That tower was destroyed in a 1955 storm and never replaced.

Forest Fire Lookout Association list shows the site as Tower Gone
evidence.quote: Buzzard Butte Tillamook 45.27801 -123.87848 Tower Gone FFLOS US 674, OR 106

corrections.why: The 30-ft tower was the first one. The 40-ft L-4 built in 1948 replaced it and is the tower destroyed or removed in the mid-1950s, so 12.2 m (40 ft) describes the tower that stood at the site last.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Oregon Forest Lookouts dates a 30-ft CCC tower to 1934; the register dates a 30-ft tower to 1948 and says it was replaced the same year. The story follows the 1934 date from Oregon Forest Lookouts and says the register differs.
Oregon Forest Lookouts says a wind storm severely damaged the lookout in 1954; the register and firelookout.com say a 1955 storm destroyed it. The story gives both and does not choose.

notes_for_editor: Four pages read; no staffing or current-site description found in them, so staffing and access are omitted. Sources disagree on the first tower's build year (1934 vs 1948) and on the storm year (1954 vs 1955); both are given in the story. Height corrected from the 30-ft figure to the 40-ft tower that stood last (brief value 9.1 m). Registered 2010 per firetower.org. Photo credits on the firelookout.com page (OSU Digital Collections, Fire Lookout Museum) have no licence shown, so no photos were added. The Forest Fire Lookout Association list is shown as one source for Tower Gone. A web search found nothing about the site today.
